      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the Kernel label and adds `btck_chainstate_manager_set_clock_time` and `SetClockTime` to `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h` and `bitcoinkernel.cpp`.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds per-instance clock time querying and injection to the C/C++ kernel API, replacing global mocktime to support deterministic concurrent kernel instances. This advances the kernel boundary by removing direct node clock dependencies and catching nondeterministic clock usage at link time."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits in mempool files are mechanical type standardizations to `NodeClock::time_point` (`MempoolTime`) following the time refactoring, without altering policy or acceptance rules.",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",

      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in test and benchmark files merely update call sites to the new API and time types; fixing an intermittent race in a validation unit test belongs to validation rather than test infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "rationale": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Split of `NodeClock::now()` into `time_nondet.cpp` is specifically designed to enforce kernel link-time constraints rather than improve general node utility infrastructure.",

      "rationale": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the Validation label and updates validation time checks across `src/validation.cpp` and `src/validation.h` to query clock time via `ChainstateManager`.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Routes header future-time validation, IBD evaluation, and progress calculation through `ChainstateManager::Now()`, eliminating global system time queries. This makes validation logic safer to test in isolation and resolves a spurious second-boundary race condition in `chainstatemanager_ibd_exit_after_loading_blocks`."
